tip.tipsmod.welcome.text: MineOctober: Get your pumpkins, pickaxe, and stock up on sweets!
tip.tipsmod.spooky.text: Ghosts and creepers are afraid of your torch... Hopefully.
tip.tipsmod.pumpkin.text: A pumpkin on your head won't make you smarter, but it will hide you from Endermen.
tip.tipsmod.candy.text: Pro tip: Don't eat mysterious candy found in caves. Or do?
tip.tipsmod.night.text: October nights are long and full of horrors. Don't leave home without a sword.
tip.tipsmod.friend.text: If a skeleton offers you a bone, it means friendship... or a challenge to a duel.
tip.tipsmod.loot.text: The best loot is the kind that doesn't bite your head off when you pick it up.
tip.tipsmod.build.text: Build a cozy cabin with a fireplace. Otherwise, someone (non-player) might move in.
tip.tipsmod.portal.text: October is the perfect time to clean up the Nether. Or to cause chaos there.
tip.tipsmod.cat.text: A black cat brings good luck. Or bad luck. Either way, it's cute.
tip.tipsmod.boss.text: If you hear ominous laughter, run. Or prepare for battle. Your choice.
tip.tipsmod.lore.text: Ancient inscriptions say: 'He who does not decorate his house will be robbed by zombies.'
tip.tipsmod.treasure.text: Mysterious chests whisper... Check them for traps before opening!
tip.tipsmod.magic.text: Enchant everything that moves. Well, your gear too.
tip.tipsmod.rain.text: October rain is great at masking the sound... of footsteps behind you.
tip.tipsmod.hamster.text: A cute hamster in your pocket is the best stress relief from creepers.
tip.tipsmod.graves.text: Graves are the spookiest way to remind you to be more careful.
tip.tipsmod.ghast.text: Not all ghosts want to set you on fire. Some are just sad.
tip.tipsmod.archeology.text: When excavating antiquities, be prepared to dig up more than just pots.
tip.tipsmod.foes.text: This October, some mobs might surprise you with new tactics... or a new face.
tip.tipsmod.critters.text: Not all creatures are scary. Some just want to make a friend.
tip.tipsmod.ribbit.text: Frogs in hats. They exist. It's not a fiction.
tip.tipsmod.affinity.text: October's magic enhances your spells. Or distorts them. Who knows...
tip.tipsmod.creeper_overhaul.text: If you hear a new hissing sound, it's not a surprise, it's a warning.
tip.tipsmod.grave_loot.text: Your grave could become the richest stash on the server. Too bad it's not for you.
tip.tipsmod.hamster_friend.text: A hamster can be cute, but when angry, it's scarier than any zombie. Don't push it.
tip.tipsmod.ancient_danger.text: Sometimes a brushing brush is needed not for pottery, but for cleaning bones... from flesh.
tip.tipsmod.spooky_companion.text: Even on the scariest night, it's less lonely with a friend.
tip.tipsmod.illusion.text: What looks like a cute rabbit might be an Illusioner. Trust, but verify.
